game: BAL@MIN Week 10 2025, kickoff 2025-11-09 13:00 ET, MIN home roof dome, MIN +4.5, total 48.5. Read logged pre-kick from the pack only.

script.base: Market expects Baltimore to lead a competitive dome game, not a blowout: MIN +4.5, total 48.5, implied BAL 26.5 and MIN 22.0. Base flow is BAL ahead by about a score late, pace normal-to-up for 48.5, and the offense leaning on Derrick Henry (64 carries, 312 yards in weeks 6/8/9) while Minnesota, a 4.5-point dog, keeps throwing to Justin Jefferson (30 targets, 200 yards) and Jordan Addison (20 targets, 202 yards) to stay in range. Starters should see a full game unless it stretches past two scores.
script.flip1: BAL gets up early, Henry's carries climb past the 21-per-game weeks 6/8/9 rate, and MIN abandons the run so Jordan Mason (29 carries, 96 yards) and Aaron Jones (14 carries, 93 yards) both die. MIN pass volume spikes to Jefferson and Addison, and BAL WR yards stall because drives finish on the ground.
script.flip2: MIN hangs around or leads on explosives. BAL has allowed 29 passes of 20+ yards (303 yards) in 8 games, which fits Jefferson (259 air yards) and Addison (319 air yards). BAL then chases, Henry's rush line falls toward the 33-yard game in his last four, and Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews and Rashod Bateman become the path to 26.5.

Who gains: Mason only if Jones is inactive, Flowers and Bateman from Okudah, Hockenson only marginally from Oliver.

pre_mortem: It is Monday and Henry under 60.5 cashed. Why? Minnesota's pass game, Jefferson on 30 targets and Addison on 20 in weeks 7-9, kept this a one-score chase or a MIN lead, and Baltimore did what the 33-yard game already showed: they stopped feeding a 21-carry plan. MIN's 4.31 YPC is not a broken run defense, and a 49% blitz can shorten drives even though BAL EPA versus blitz is +0.12. Huntley already ripped 92 yards on 11 carries in the same three-game window, so the explosive can live on the change-of-pace back while Henry grinds into a stacked box. Okudah being out can also pull play-calls toward Flowers (218 air yards) instead of Henry. The number may have been short with no saved price, so even a modest yardage win would have been a bad bet. That counter is real and is why the leg is flagged, but it is not stronger than 122, 71 and 119 in the current window plus a favorite script, so the leg is not dropped.
